name: Loop Falls, Paluma
description:
Good afternoon Bush Walkers!

Please find attached the registration link for this weekend's walk.

The meeting time and place will be included in a separate email sent to those that successfully register.

Loop falls is an approximately  half day walk which includes several opportunities for swimming. This is a rough, uneven track and will involve plenty of rock hopping and a good chance of getting your feet wet.

Make sure you wear comfortable closed shoes, sun-safe clothing, bring adequate water  for the day and a lunch. 

This form is for -23 Feb, 2025
Loop falls - https://forms.gle/NV7NFMztsW7TBEEn8

Led by Ian Wallace
Grade of walk activity - On track, Steep, rock hopping, some climbing- Moderate grade difficulty. Adequate fitness needed.

Loop Falls, Halifax Track- 23 Feb 2025 - Google Forms https://forms.gle/NV7NFMztsW7TBEEn8

name: Crystal Ck Falls and Junction Falls + Wilfred's Lookout Circuit
description:
Upcoming Adventures – February
Subject to weather as always this month.
We are kicking off with:
Sunday, 16th Feb - Crystal Ck Falls and Junction Falls + Wilfred's Lookout Circuit. Perfect for fit beginners and experienced hikers alike!. Cherry is leading - get in touch with her to RSVP - info@townsvillebushwalkingclub.com

We'll add more after the dinner Meet and Greet this week and we'll send out an email with details. Keep an eye on your inbox and our Facebook page for updates!

Get Involved!

We love making these adventures happen, but we need your help! Whether it’s suggesting a new trail, co-leading a hike, or just helping spread the word, every little bit helps to keep this amazing community thriving. If you’d like to get involved, let’s chat at the Meet & Greet or reply to this email!

Looking forward to catching up with you all soon and kicking off 2025 with some epic hikes!

Happy Trails,

Warm Regards,
Cherry Judge
Secretary

name: Meet & Greet – Let’s Plan the Year Together!
description:
Meet & Greet – Let’s Plan the Year Together!
Before we hit the trails, let’s catch up over a drink and dinner! 

Join us at Riverview Tavern, Douglas [ 247/251 Riverside Blvd, Douglas] on Thursday, 6th February, at 6:00 PM for a relaxed and informal Meet & Greet. This is the perfect opportunity to reconnect with old friends, welcome new faces, and most importantly, help shape the adventure calendar for the first quarter of 2025. 

If you have a trail you’ve been dying to explore or a favorite hike you’d love to revisit, we want to hear about it!. 

To join us, please RSVP, as we need to let the Tavern know approximate numbers. You can just sms or call Cherry - 0430073341 OR just email the club. You can let us know right till Thursday morning.
